name: Periodic Table
description: Element tiles for building periodic table layouts. Each tile shows symbol, atomic number, and group color.

orientation.comment: Each grid cell = 12cm. Wall-mounted table, X=left/right (groups), Y=up/down (periods).

presets.name: Periods 1-3
presets.description: First 18 elements — hydrogen through argon. Core chemistry building blocks.

presets.name: Alkali Metals
presets.description: Group 1 column — Li, Na, K, Rb, Cs, Fr. Most reactive metals.

presets.name: Noble Gases
presets.description: Group 18 column — He, Ne, Ar, Kr, Xe, Rn. Chemically inert.

presets.name: Transition Row (Period 4)
presets.description: First row of transition metals — Sc through Zn. The d-block.

presets.name: Full Periodic Table
presets.description: Complete periodic table — all 118 elements in standard layout with lanthanide and actinide rows.
